name: Simple Parchment
label: Quest
description: Simple Parchment: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What's that you have there? A parchment? You're not a scholar, I hope...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, that's my parchment. I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, friend. I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the adventurer.
Good luck, friend, and return to me whenever you feel ready.
